Variants.Content: Crake Hall is the western seat of the Kraihe family, and is surrounded by hilly areas suitable for farming, animal husbandry and hunting. Common prey such as rails are included in place names, indicating that the aristocratic culture here not only included feasting and hunting, horses and knighthood, but also relied on the harvest of ordinary land. The honor of a vassal in the West is often measured by the number of men in armor and the family banner, but behind every knight there is a steward, a blacksmith, a farmer, a mill, and fields that can supply oats. Crake Hall should not be reduced to a backdrop for a particular war; it was a long-running manorial society with obligations to Casterly Rock and local resources that determined how much they could shoulder.

They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
